concepts.def: Total cost greater than total revenue
Price per unit charged to customers
Graph showing revenue and cost vs output

walkthroughs.body_html:
Margin of safety = actual sales − break-even sales.

It shows how far sales can fall before the firm starts losing money.

Once past break-even, every extra unit's contribution is pure profit.

Profit = (units − break-even units) × contribution per unit.

Fixed £8,000. Price £20. VC £12. Contribution £8. Break-even = 8000/8 = 1,000 units.

If actual sales 1,500: margin of safety = 500. Profit = 500 × £8 = £4,000.
